def validate_probe(value,outer,exe,host_identity):
    fields={'schema','observed_host','sys_platform','pointer_bits','blender_version','blender_build_hash','blender_binary','blender_binary_sha256','python_runtime','python_runtime_sha256','fbx_addon_file','background','autoexec_disabled','source_saved','rendered'}
    require(type(value) is dict and set(value)==fields,'host probe fields differ')
    require(value['schema']=='rust-duty-official-blender-host-observation/v2','host probe schema differs')
    require(value['sys_platform']=='win32' and type(value['pointer_bits']) is int and value['pointer_bits']==64,'native 64-bit Windows host probe required')
    native=host_identity.validate_observed_host(value['observed_host'])
    host_identity.compare_cross_role(outer,native)
    require(value['blender_version']==[4,3,2] and value['blender_binary_sha256']==sha(exe),'observed Blender binary/version differs')
    require(value['blender_binary']==str(exe),'observed Blender executable path differs')
    require(type(value['blender_build_hash']) is str and bool(value['blender_build_hash'].strip()),'observed Blender build hash absent')
    require(value['background'] is True and value['autoexec_disabled'] is True and value['source_saved'] is False and value['rendered'] is False,'unexpected host probe action')
    pin(value['python_runtime'],value['python_runtime_sha256'])
    return native

    require(sys.platform=='win32' and ctypes.sizeof(ctypes.c_void_p)==8,'actual native 64-bit Windows controller required')
    observed_host={k:getattr(platform,k)() for k in ('system','release','version','machine')}
    host_identity.validate_observed_host(observed_host)
